description: Source code for parsing and handling HTTP cookies, including token parsing, validation, and serialization functions within the Chromium project.

classes.name: ParsedCookie
classes.description: Class representing a parsed HTTP cookie with methods for validation, attribute setting, and serialization.

methods.name: ParsedCookie
methods.description: Constructor that parses a cookie line into a ParsedCookie object, updating status.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the parsed cookie is valid.

methods.name: SameSite
methods.description: Returns the SameSite attribute of the cookie.

methods.name: Priority
methods.description: Returns the priority of the cookie.

methods.name: SetName
methods.description: Sets the cookie's name after validation.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets the cookie's value after validation.

methods.name: SetPath
methods.description: Sets the Path attribute.

methods.name: SetDomain
methods.description: Sets the Domain attribute.

methods.name: SetExpires
methods.description: Sets the Expires attribute.

methods.name: SetMaxAge
methods.description: Sets the Max-Age attribute.

methods.name: SetIsSecure
methods.description: Sets the Secure attribute.

methods.name: SetIsHttpOnly
methods.description: Sets the HttpOnly attribute.

methods.name: SetSameSite
methods.description: Sets the SameSite attribute.

methods.name: SetPriority
methods.description: Sets the Priority attribute.

methods.name: SetIsSameParty
methods.description: Sets the SameParty attribute.

methods.name: SetIsPartitioned
methods.description: Sets the Partitioned attribute.

methods.name: ToCookieLine
methods.description: Serializes the cookie into a cookie line string.

methods.name: FindFirstTerminator
methods.description: Finds the first terminator character in a string.

methods.name: ParseToken
methods.description: Parses a token from a string iterator.

methods.name: ParseValue
methods.description: Parses a value from a string iterator.

methods.name: ParseTokenString
methods.description: Extracts a token string, stopping at terminators.

methods.name: ParseValueString
methods.description: Returns a validated cookie value string.

methods.name: ValueMatchesParsedValue
methods.description: Checks if a value string matches its parsed form.

methods.name: IsValidCookieName
methods.description: Validates a cookie name against allowed characters.

methods.name: IsValidCookieValue
methods.description: Validates a cookie value against allowed characters.

methods.name: CookieAttributeValueHasValidCharSet
methods.description: Checks if attribute value has valid characters.

methods.name: CookieAttributeValueHasValidSize
methods.description: Checks if attribute value size is within limits.

methods.name: IsValidCookieNameValuePair
methods.description: Validates a name-value pair for cookies.

methods.name: ParseTokenValuePairs
methods.description: Parses all token/value pairs from a cookie string.

methods.name: SetupAttributes
methods.description: Initializes attribute indices based on parsed pairs.

methods.name: SetString
methods.description: Sets a string attribute after validation.

methods.name: SetBool
methods.description: Sets a boolean attribute.

methods.name: SetAttributePair
methods.description: Adds or updates an attribute key/value pair.

methods.name: ClearAttributePair
methods.description: Removes an attribute pair and updates indices.
